summary: SOLAI Limited, a US-domiciled foreign private issuer (formerly BIT Mining and 500.com), disclosed on Form 6-K that independent director Zhan Chen resigned effective August 21, 2026, exiting the audit, nominating and corporate governance, and strategic planning committees, and that CFO Qiang Yuan resigned effective August 31, 2026. Both departures were stated as not resulting from any disagreement over operations, policies or practices. No successor, interim appointee, severance, or advisor was named. The dual abrupt exits leave two key seats vacant; watch for replacement timing and any accounting or disclosure issues given the near-simultaneous timing.
